name: 01301 · Greenfield, MA
findings: ZIP 01301 (Greenfield) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01301 (Greenfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01301 (Greenfield) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
